The present writ petition has been filed seeking direction to the opposite parties to pay the compensation and all the benefits to the petitioner under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2023 and the Rules made thereunder along with the accrued interest within a stipulated period.

sentences.text: 4. In course of hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner may be granted liberty to pursue her remedy before the appropriate authority by filing a fresh representation, to MANOR Digitally by signed ANJAN SAMAL MANORANJAN which learned counsel for opposite party no.1 has no objection.

In view of the above, this Court directs that in the event the petitioner files a fresh representation before the authority concerned within ten days from today, the said authority shall consider and dispose of the same in accordance with law within a period of three months thereafter.
6. With the above observation, the writ petition stands disposed of.
